embeds.title: 🧩 About DeezOps
embeds.description:
We're a Discord ops agency. Channels, bots, branding, tickets, automations — the stuff that makes a server feel real.

Tired of a Discord that looks unfinished? **That's literally the job.**

fields.name: What we fix
fields.value: Messy roles, dead welcome flows, zero branding, bots that don't talk to each other, mods drowning in tickets.
